summary: Investcorp Credit Management BDC, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a sixth amendment to its Loan, Security and Collateral Management Agreement, decreasing the facility size from $100 million to $50 million. The amendment was entered by a wholly-owned subsidiary as borrower, with lenders, Capital One as agent, and CM Investment Partners as collateral manager. No price, premium, close date, or break fee are stated; the filing only details a credit facility reduction. This is a routine debt facility amendment, not a special situation. Non-US elements are absent; the BDC is US-based. What to watch: the facility reduction may indicate portfolio deleveraging, but no event-driven catalyst is present.
